key_highlights: ASX records fourth consecutive losing week as rising bond yields pressure equities; 'will bonds crash stocks' debate intensifies
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite sharp unemployment jump, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences sharp depreciation ('trapdoor opens'), raising import costs and pressure on rate-sensitive sectors
Housing market correction exceeds halfway point to largest 40-year decline; Victorian unemployment disproportionately elevated
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags structural fiscal gap, reinforcing case for tax reform
Small-cap mining remains active: Anax Metals, Many Peaks, MinRex, Micro-X, Arrow Minerals, Mamba among weekly movers; $2.7B cap raise activity
Gold exploration positive: Aurum 155g/t hit, Zenith six-for-six in WA, Auric high-grade beyond Munda pit shell
Rio2 launches major drill programme at Peruvian copper asset; Vista Gold (VGZ) agrees to sale
Data centre energy demand boom strains Australian power grid, creating both opportunity and risk for energy names
Geopolitical escalation: Ukraine-Russia drone exchange, China-US tensions add risk premium

sectors.trend: Exploratory gold and copper names showing strong technical momentum; cap raise activity at $2.7B weekly level signals speculative appetite despite macro headwinds. Rio2 Peruvian copper drill and WA gold hits support sector sentiment.
sectors.implications: Micro-cap miners (Anax, Many Peaks, MinRex, Micro-X, Arrow, Mamba) offer asymmetric upside but carry dilution risk. Large-caps (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face pressure from AUD weakness and global growth concerns. Gold names benefit from safe-haven flows amid geopolitical risk.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance despite rising unemployment creates margin pressure vs credit loss risk. Intergenerational Report 2026 highlights fiscal vulnerability. Renters' financial stress (50%+ struggling) signals rising NPL risk.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face a difficult balance: higher rates support NIM but deteriorating household balance sheets threaten credit quality. REITs (property lenders) under pressure from 40-year house price decline.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom driving structural power demand surge, straining grid capacity. Energy bust risk from oversupply or policy misalignment. Star casino licence suspension affects gaming revenue.
sectors.implications: Energy generators (AGL.AX, CGP.AX, GWD.AX) benefit from sustained demand but face capex pressure. Gaming (SGH.AX) hit by Star licence suspension. Renewable/infrastructure plays gain policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Adelaide hospital ED strain signals public health system stress. Medicare data breach prompts AI safety legislation debate. Consumer staples under pressure from interest rate pincer and housing correction.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX offer defensive positioning. Healthcare infrastructure and private hospital (IAG.AX, HIC.AX) may benefit from public system strain. Consumer discretionary faces headwinds.

sectors.trend: Global AI chip race intensifies (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, SK Hynix). Australian small business AI adoption accelerating. Medicare breach drives domestic AI safety regulation.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names limited but global AI capex cycle supports hardware/electronics supply chains. Domestic AI regulation may create compliance cost for listed firms. Salesforce/AMD developments signal continued global tech momentum.

sectors.trend: Housing correction at halfway to 40-year high decline. CBD commercial property under pressure (library tower $40m listing). Dusty Martin $20m portfolio haircut signals sentiment shift.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICPL.AX) face valuation compression. Residential construction (WBC.AX exposure) softens. Commercial REITs vulnerable to rising yields and falling occupier demand.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1-3 month window. Rising bond yields, AUD weakness, and RBA hawkishness create headwinds. Fourth consecutive losing week suggests momentum is negative. However, 'everything crashes except stocks' dynamic may provide a floor as bond markets absorb the shock. Expect volatility around RBA commentary and employment data. Small-cap mining may outperform on relative value.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious but not bearish. Intergenerational Report 2026 tax reform could provide fiscal stabilisation. Housing correction nearing completion may support eventual recovery. Data centre energy demand and gold pipeline offer structural growth pockets. Key risk is RBA-induced recession if unemployment continues rising. Global AI capex cycle supports technology supply chains.
